topic: What is Logistics Management? - Camcode · Part 4/4

passage.text: When a company outsources its transportation and storage processes, it works with a third-party logistics provider, or 3PL. Some 3PLs only offer transportation, while others offer a wider range of services, such as warehouse storage, inventory management, and shipping, providing complete logistics management. Third-party logistics is ideal for companies that do not have the resources to build and manage their own logistics processes. It also enables companies to focus on their core capabilities, such as manufacturing, marketing, and sales, while leaving complex logistics processes in the hands of an experienced 3PL provider.

source.title: What is Logistics Management? Why is It Important? - Camcode

taps.prompt: What is the main idea of the text?
taps.correct: Outsourcing logistics to 3PL providers allows companies to focus on their core business while experts handle transportation and storage.
wrong: Third-party logistics providers are cheaper than managing your own warehouse storage.
All companies must outsource their logistics to remain competitive in business.
taps.explain: The excerpt explains the purpose and benefit of using 3PLs, not cost or necessity.

taps.context: Some 3PLs only offer transportation, while others offer a wider range of services, such as warehouse storage, inventory management, and shipping, providing complete logistics management.
taps.correct: Different 3PLs provide different services; some handle only transportation, others manage full logistics.
wrong: All 3PLs provide complete logistics management including transportation and storage.
Transportation is the only service that all 3PLs offer to companies.
taps.explain: The original describes variation; wrong options claim uniformity or exclusivity.

taps.correct: Third-party logistics is ideal for companies that do not have the resources to build and manage their own logistics processes.
wrong: Third-party logistics works best for companies that do not have the resources to build and manage their own logistics processes.
taps.explain: 'Ideal' is a softening word suggesting suitability rather than absolute necessity.
